title: Sketchpad Platform Refactor
description: Rename ProductRuntime to Platform; replace board/scene3d with table/puzzle2d/puzzle3d/puzzle5d/cad/panel component kinds; rewrite sketchpad as declarative Platform instance with home/kit table + kit diagram slice.
summary: Expanded kit diagram topology to match legacy buildKitDiagramData: types, designs, qualities (key/value), ports (from type ports + connector refs), files, folders, authors, with part-of and reference edges. Extended SKETCHPAD_KIT_READ_INNER GraphQL fragment and DTO parsing. Kit table lists all entity kinds; board node navigation supports query-param routes for non-type/design nodes. Added sketchpadCollectKitPorts helper and tests (18/18 passing).
